books.title: What Happened After the Cross?
books.subtitle: A Mission Through Acts
books.description: Follow the gospel from Calvary into the lives of the first believers. Through the conversion accounts in Acts, John P. Kennon explores repentance, baptism in Jesus’ name, and the gift of the Holy Ghost as a consistent apostolic pattern of the new birth.

books.title: Conquering Leviathan
books.description: A literary and theological story of faithfulness, surrender, and the life that follows. As Elior confronts the limits of self-rule, the journey asks what it means to remain dependent on God rather than merely appearing righteous.

books.title: Seven Altars Can’t Buy One Word from God
books.description: From the mountains of Moab to the Upper Room, the story of Balak and Balaam exposes the limits of religious bargaining. This journey explores the unchanging Word of God and the revelation that leads a heart into obedient faith.

books.title: A Vision of the Harvest
books.description: A devotional journey through the harvest field of faith, grace, and spiritual growth. Drawing on the image of humanity as God’s field, these reflections invite readers to become fruitful laborers who nurture the lives entrusted to them.

books.title: Position and Placement
books.description: How does God prepare a believer for the work He calls them to do? Through biblical teaching and the journey of Ephraim and Silas, this book explores spiritual maturity, obedience, and the relationship between preparation and divine assignment.

books.title: Untimely
books.description: An honest account of a family’s journey through sudden loss, grief, forgiveness, and faith. John P. Kennon reflects on learning to trust God when life’s hardest questions remain unanswered and grace must be found one day at a time.

books.title: When God Draws a Line in the Sand
books.description: Through the story of Exodus, this work explores the faithfulness of God’s covenant amid oppression, uncertainty, and deliverance. Readers are invited to trust the One whose promises stand when circumstances say otherwise.

books.title: A Prophet’s Tale
books.description: A unified manuscript tracing the long reach of influence, rebellion, repentance, and redemption. Through Israel’s kings and the encounter at Samaria’s well, it asks how choices become a legacy and how revelation can change a generation.

books.title: When the Lines Grow Gray
books.description: When neglected boundaries become difficult to see, confusion begins to feel normal. Drawing from Ezekiel and the believer’s priesthood, this teaching calls readers toward clear discernment, personal consecration, and obedience shaped by conviction and grace.

books.title: When the Lines Grow Gray — Companion Study Workbook
books.description: Guided notes, Scripture observations, and personal application help readers slow down, examine the lesson, and practice grace-led discernment in everyday life.

books.title: Broken at the Well
books.description: At Jacob’s well, one encounter reaches beyond a woman’s shame into the wounded history of Samaria. This teaching follows the promise of living water toward the revival of Acts 8 and the hope that broken places can become places of restoration.

books.title: Lord, Teach Me to Pray
books.description: For the believer who has a hunger to pray but struggles to find the words, this practical teaching explores prayer as relationship and response. Scripture, reflection, and personal testimony point toward a life led by faith and the Holy Ghost.

books.title: A Prayer Journal
books.description: A collection of Scripture-rooted prayers and declarations for growth in grace, faith, understanding, and Kingdom service. Designed to give direction to personal prayer and help the reader respond to the Word.

books.title: The Lord’s Prayer — Study and Devotional Journal
books.description: Explore the Lord’s Prayer through its themes of relationship, worship, surrender, provision, forgiveness, and deliverance. Reflection prompts help turn each subject into a personal conversation with God.

books.title: Learning to Trust Again
books.description: When anxiety carries the memory of broken trust, the faithfulness of God offers a place to begin again. This teaching reflects on His daily provision and the invitation to entrust tomorrow to Him.

books.title: Marriage and Communication
books.description: A practical study for couples who want to talk honestly and grow together. Scripture, conversation starters, and shared exercises address money, time, responsibility, and the everyday choices that shape a marriage.

books.title: Still Speaking
books.description: A biblical case for the continuing work of the Holy Ghost in the church. This booklet examines Pentecost, spiritual gifts, and the promise extended to believers beyond the first generation of apostles.

books.title: The Sword, the Sickle, and the Shield
books.description: The Word, the harvest, and the shield of faith become pictures of a believer equipped for service. This teaching connects spiritual readiness, holiness, and obedience with the work of reaching and strengthening people.

books.title: The Bloom in the Battle
books.description: Drawing from Isaiah 35, this message looks for the life God brings to barren places. It offers encouragement to strengthen weak hands, refuse fear, and believe that a wilderness can yet blossom.

books.title: Three Mantles
books.description: Sonship, parenthood, and the responsibility of spiritual legacy form the three mantles explored in this teaching. Its call is to grow in wisdom, serve faithfully in small things, and carry each season with love.

books.title: How Were You Baptized? — For Kids
books.description: An introductory teaching draft that brings the subject of baptism and the new birth to younger readers. Its questions and explanations are intended to help children begin exploring the biblical message.

books.title: Source and Supply
books.description: Spiritual exhaustion can reveal where self-reliance has replaced dependence on Christ. This teaching explores grace, humility, and the strength God supplies when believers learn to abide in Him.

books.title: The Blessings in Brokenness
books.description: The Beatitudes open a path toward understanding surrender, suffering, and hope. This teaching considers how a broken life can still carry God’s light and how grace gives purpose to the pieces.

books.title: Be Careful of the One You Put to Flight
books.description: A reflection on Deuteronomy 32 and the far-reaching consequences of rejection, unity, and covenant faithfulness. This teaching urges care with the people and influences that shape a shared spiritual future.

songs.title: Higher Ground
songs.description: When the storms of life close in, an unshakable anchor holds. Higher Ground lifts the eyes toward the mercy of Jesus and the promise of seeing Him face to face.

songs.title: We Will Overcome
songs.description: A bold gospel declaration of overcoming faith through the blood of the Lamb, giving the church words of courage, testimony, and praise.

songs.title: Still I Rise
songs.description: A declaration of faith that survives fire, flood, and the darkest night. With grace holding on through every scar, the song rises toward victory in Jesus’ name and the hope of heaven.

songs.title: Living by Faith
songs.description: A declaration of trust beyond what the eyes can see. Through trials and uncertain days, the hand of the Lord remains steady and His promises give reason to keep walking.

songs.title: A Beautiful Redemption
songs.description: A testimony of brokenness met by grace, celebrating the hope and restoration found in Jesus.

songs.title: From Trouble to Testimony
songs.description: A declaration of faith formed through pressure and waiting, tracing the road from struggle to a testimony of what God has done.

songs.title: More Than Conquerors
songs.description: Rooted in Romans 8, this song declares victory through the love of Christ and the assurance that nothing can separate His people from Him.

songs.title: Let the Redeemed Say So
songs.description: Drawing on Psalm 107, this song gives voice to people brought out of wandering, bondage, sickness, and storms by the God who answers their cries.

songs.title: I’ve Been Redeemed
songs.description: A joyful testimony of sins washed away, life made new, and freedom through the blood of the Lamb, looking ahead to the promised land.

songs.title: I Am a Soldier
songs.description: A declaration of steadfast faith in the Lord’s army, grounded in His Word, redeemed by His blood, and determined to remain faithful.

songs.title: I’ve Got Too Much to Lose
songs.description: A determined declaration that the grace, forgiveness, and victories already received are too precious to abandon. The road continues forward in faith.

songs.title: Closer to Your Throne
songs.description: A prayer for the nearness of God above everything the world can offer, finding renewed faith and freedom from fear in His presence.

songs.title: Fallow Ground
songs.description: A prayer for God to break the hardened places of the heart, plant fresh faith, and bring life to ground that has waited through a difficult season.

songs.title: Picking Up the Pieces
songs.description: A testimony of shattered dreams met by restoring grace, finding that the broken pieces of a life can become the beginning of something new in God’s hands.

songs.title: Back Home
songs.description: After rejection and broken belonging, an open door becomes a picture of grace. Back Home tells of finding welcome, acceptance, and a place where your name is still known.

songs.title: Porch Light On
songs.description: A father’s love keeps the door open without demanding explanations. This country ballad offers forgiveness, belonging, and the quiet assurance that home is still waiting.

songs.title: Angels Wings
songs.description: A tender song of grief, remembrance, and the hope of reunion in heaven, written to bring comfort to hearts carrying loss.

songs.title: I Hope You’re There
songs.description: A heartfelt look toward heaven, the Savior, and a home beyond sorrow, carrying the hope that those we love will be there too.

songs.title: Sunrise
songs.description: A song of love and second chances, holding to the belief that every sunset makes room for a sunrise and that a life shared in love is worth believing in.

songs.title: Sounds Like Livin’
songs.description: A country song about love and the everyday moments that make life worth living.

songs.title: When All I Have Is You
